description: Implement all client-side controllers: Main.client.lua entry point, UIController (Pet Simulator 1 style UI with all screens), PetController (pet following, attack animations), CampaignController (battle UI and lane visualization), and EffectsController (number popups, egg hatching animation, zone unlock effects)
steps: Create src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/Client/Main.client.lua - client entry point that initializes all controllers, connects to RemoteEvents, sets up input handling

Create src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/Client/UIController.lua - Full Pet Simulator 1 style UI system. Must create via code (no external assets): (1) Top-right currency display with coin icon (yellow circle) and diamond icon (blue diamond shape) stacked vertically with large numbers, (2) Bottom-center XP/level bar with level number, (3) Bottom-right navigation buttons as colored squares: Pets (green), Upgrades (orange), Shop (blue), Settings (gray), (4) Pet inventory screen: grid of pet cards showing name/rarity/damage with equip/delete/multi-select, (5) Upgrade window: large centered frame with thick border, grid of upgrade cards (Friendship, Diamonds, Extra Slots, etc.) each showing level/cost/buy button, big X close button, (6) Egg purchase UI when near egg, (7) Campaign level select screen accessed via portal. All buttons large, rounded (UICorner), colorful with thick UIStroke borders. Responsive layout using UDim2 scale values.

Create src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/Client/PetController.lua - manages pet visuals following the player. Creates procedural pet models (simple Part-based: body sphere + head sphere colored by rarity). Pets orbit player, animate toward destructibles to attack, return. Handle equip/unequip visual updates. Show floating damage numbers when pets hit targets.

Create src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/Client/CampaignController.lua - campaign battle UI. Shows lane view (2D-style left-to-right). Player base left, enemy base right with HP bars. Energy bar that regenerates. Pet deployment cards at bottom with energy costs. Shows pets and enemies moving on the lane as simple colored Parts. Victory/defeat screen with rewards.

Create src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/Client/EffectsController.lua - visual effects: (1) Floating number popups (+10 coins, +5 diamonds) that rise and fade, (2) Egg hatching animation (egg model shakes, cracks, reveals pet with particle burst), (3) Zone unlock gate animation (gate dissolves/opens), (4) Progress bars above destructibles showing remaining HP, (5) Collection magnet effect (coins fly toward player), (6) Pet rarity reveal glow effects (Common=white, Uncommon=green, Rare=blue, Epic=purple, Legendary=gold)
acceptance_criteria: Main.client.lua properly initializes all controllers and connects RemoteEvents
UIController creates complete UI hierarchy with all screens (inventory, upgrades, campaign select, shop)
Currency display always visible with coin and diamond icons/counts
Navigation buttons are large, colored, rounded squares at bottom-right
Upgrade window has centered modal with kachel/tile upgrade cards and X close button
PetController creates procedural pet models that follow the player
CampaignController shows lane-based battle with energy system and deployment cards
EffectsController handles number popups, egg animations, and zone unlock effects
All UI uses UDim2 scale values for responsive layout (works on PC, tablet, phone)
No external assets referenced - all visuals created procedurally via Parts and UI elements
verification: Run: find /projects/Roblox-game/src/StarterPlayer -name '*.lua' | sort to confirm all files exist

Run: python3 -c "import os; controllers=['UIController','PetController','CampaignController','EffectsController']; assert all(os.path.exists(f'/projects/Roblox-game/src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/Client/{c}.lua') for c in controllers)"
Verify UIController references all required UI elements by searching for keywords: UICorner, UIStroke, UDim2, Coins, Diamonds, Upgrades, Pets
findings: All 5 client-side controller files created successfully. UIController has 28 UICorner, 15 UIStroke, 123 UDim2, 95 fromScale, 33 GothamBold references ensuring proper Pet Simulator 1 style. No rbxlx file exists yet (expected from FEAT-004). All files pass basic syntax checks. Main.client.lua connects all RemoteEvents/Functions listed in the plan. Total: 1405 lines across all controllers.
